==Description==
The '''Roblox Core Pack - Badlands Heist''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in July 2021. The toy contains the Level 5 [[Cowboy]]. When you buy the toy, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the {{RLinkC|6532550987|Withered Top Hat}} accessory on Roblox. You can also buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Badlands Heist''' with two mystery figures, one from the Series 10 and the other from Series 8 of the Roblox Toy line. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:From the shadows of BelowNatural's Tower Defense Simulator, this well-disguised desperado has the firepower and nerve to cut down any zombies in his sights, before they even know what hit ‘em. Conditioned to the rugged Badlands terrain, he's trigger-ready to wipe his enemies off the map, save the day, and tell the tale.
*'''On Pack'''
*:From BelowNatural's thrilling Tower Defense Simulator, this well-disguised desperado has the firepower to cut down any zombies in his sights.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $6.99-$12.97 in the US, £9.70 in the UK and €11.58 in the EU. There may be additional costs if you buy this pack with two mystery figures.

The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability.

The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensible list:

*[https://www.walmart.com/ip/Roblox-Action-Collection-Tower-Defense-Simulator-Badlands-Heist-Core-2-Mystery-Figure-Bundle-Includes-Exclusive-Virtual-Item/107178674 Walmart] (US, Canada & Mexico)

==Trivia==
*Weirdly, the gatling gun and cash bag that comes from the '''Roblox Core Pack - Badlands Heist''' were used by older versions of the [[Cowboy]], but the [[Cowboy]] figure is based on the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]'s Level 5 Default [[Cowboy]], which did not have a gatling gun or cash bag.
*The {{RLinkC|6532550987|Withered Top Hat}} accessory, which is the virtual item that comes from this figure, was never used by the [[Cowboy]] in the game.
**However, it is very similar to the top hat used by the [[Summoner Boss]].
